messages:
Nina (Finance): Heads up - TidalWave invoice INV-2026-1410 marked 60+ days delinquent. Client emailed asking for short-term hold and a 3-month installment plan. ACH returned last attempt.
BillingBot: Automated alert: ACH return R01 for INV-2026-1410. Amount $28,750. Original due date: 2026-02-27. https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-1410
Omar (AE): Just talked to their Finance Manager. They had a quarter-end revenue shift and want to split into 3 monthly payments. They stressed minimizing product disruption — onboarding still in progress.
Lilly (Collections): Standard asks: signed addendum, autopay enabled, and first installment must clear before we pause any suspension. We can pause external dunning but keep internal collections reminders.
Evan (Finance Director): We can accept 3-month split only if first installment clears within 5 business days of agreement and a card on file is authorized. No fee waivers yet. We can review waiver after clearing.
Legal Ops: I'll pull the short-form payment-plan addendum and include autopay + default language. Send the proposed dates and payment method and I'll attach.
Omar (AE): Customer proposal:
```
INV-2026-1410 total $28,750
1) $9,583 due on agreement (ASAP)
2) $9,583 due 2026-06-10
3) $9,584 due 2026-07-10
Request: pause daily dunning while first payment pending.
```
Lilly (Collections): Fine. I'll prepare the outgoing email and include explicit clause: failure of installment 1 -> immediate suspension and fees reinstated. Also note retry attempts for ACH.
BillingBot: Note: recommend manual ACH retry only after customer authorizes. Current external dunning paused by collections flag.
Nina (Finance): Please CC finance on outbound. Once the first payment clears I will move the invoice to "on-plan" and update AR aging.
Evan (Finance Director): Approved conditional plan as stated. Collections to execute and Legal to finalize addendum. If first payment fails, we reinstate hold same day.
Omar (AE): I'll collect card auth on the call tomorrow and post the signed addendum here. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
